channel.title: FFIP LinkedIn rotation
channel.description: Fly Fishing Insider Podcast articles queued for LinkedIn

item.title: Yellowstone Dry Fly Tips From a Veteran Guide | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Yellowstone and Madison River guide Alice Owsley shares dry fly tips: fish one fly, choose nylon leaders, use a sharpie, and observe before you cast.

item.title: How Fly Lines Are Built | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Scientific Anglers president Brad Befus explains fly line cores, coatings, textures and tapers, and how to pick the right line for your water.

item.title: Where Fish Live: The FEES Method for Reading Trout Water | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Use FEES (food, energy, efficiency, safety) to read any river and find the lies where trout actually sit, instead of fishing empty water.

item.title: Baseline Streamer Tactics: Swing vs. Jerk Strip | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Two baseline streamer retrieves explained: the in-alignment swing and the across-the-current jerk strip, and when to choose each one.

item.title: Fish New Water on Every Cast and Catch More Fish | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Stop casting to the same spot. Learn the new-water approach to fly fishing: better drifts, fewer spooked fish, and more opportunities.

item.title: Costa Rica Fly Fishing: Machaca, Tarpon and Rooster Fish with Jesse Males | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Jesse Males on fly fishing Costa Rica: jungle-river machaca on eight weights, Caribbean tarpon, surf-caught rooster fish, and the rigs behind them.

item.title: Tying Streamers That Hold Up | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Hunter Derrek of Meat Market Flies on building streamers that survive big fish: hook choice, proven patterns, and tying for how you really fish.

item.title: Building a Better Fly Box | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Montana Fly Company on choosing quality flies, where new patterns come from, and picking a fly box that survives boat days. Lessons from the podcast.

item.title: Smallmouth Bass on the Fly: Fish Depth, Not Patterns | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Wisconsin guide Joe Davies breaks down smallmouth on the fly: fish depth before pattern, work structure, and rig a short, stout leader for big river bass.

item.title: Dry Flies, Bamboo Rods, and Slowing Down: Spencer Durrant | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Spencer Durrant of MidCurrent on dry-fly fishing, a simple Rocky Mountain dry-dropper rig, and why bamboo rods make you a slower, better angler.

item.title: How to Host a Fly Fishing Film Night: Mariko Izumi | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Mariko Izumi on growing up in a Canadian fishing family, traveling for TV, and how anyone can host a fly fishing film screening in their town.

item.title: Better Fish Handling: Purist on the Fly | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Purist on the Fly on fish handling ethics, plus a practical catch-and-release routine for faster releases, safer photos, and healthier fish.

item.title: Colton McLaren: Triple Nymph Rigs and Mysis Tailwaters | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Colorado guide Colton McLaren on triple nymph rigs, fishing Mysis shrimp tailwaters like the Blue River, and how to wade a big freestone like the Upper Colorado.

item.title: Why Fly Anglers Should Care About Hunting Policy | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Hunters and anglers fund conservation together. How the user-pay model works, why policy fights spread state to state, and how to contact the right decision makers.

item.title: How to Start a Fly Fishing Community | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: How Marsh Sessions grew from a brewery tying night into a 450-person Florida fly fishing festival, plus a playbook for starting a fishing community of your own.

item.title: Striped Marlin on the Fly in Magdalena Bay, Baja | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Joseph Zaragoza of Salt Junkies Inc on fly fishing striped marlin at Mag Bay: bait balls vs. teasing, 12-weight rigs, shock leaders, and fast strips.

item.title: Planning an Alaska Fly-Out Trip: Silvers, Rainbows, and Timing | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Live from an Alaska lodge: when to book for sockeye, silvers, and big rainbows, how fly-outs work, and the steak-and-eggs rig for trout behind spawners.

item.title: Lid Rig Mag Box Pro Review: Magnetic Fly Box
item.description: Hands-on Lid Rig Mag Box Pro review: how its magnetic inserts and swappable fly docks hold flies, verified specs, scorecard, and who should buy it.

item.title: Simms Dry Creek Z Hip Pack Review
item.description: Hands-on Simms Dry Creek Z Hip Pack review: TRU Zip waterproof zipper, 420D TPU-coated nylon, net-ready strap, and how it scores for fly fishing.

item.title: Sage ESN 4wt 10ft Fly Rod Review: Euro Nymphing
item.description: Hands-on Sage ESN 4100-4 review: a 10 ft 4wt European nymphing rod with KonneticHD graphite, soft-tip tippet protection, and real backbone for bigger trout.

item.title: Black Diamond Solution 1.0 Hoody Review
item.description: Black Diamond Solution 1.0 Hoody reviewed for fly fishing: PrimaLoft Gold Cross Core, stretch side panels, and why synthetic insulation beats down when wet.

item.title: Euro Nymphing Explained: George Daniel | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: George Daniel breaks down euro nymphing: thin leaders, a sighter off the water, leading the flies, and why soft-tip rods beat indicators for detecting strikes.

item.title: Whitewater Fly Fishing the Flathead with Hilary Hutcheson | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Hilary Hutcheson on whitewater fly fishing the Flathead near Glacier: safety first, four rigs in one boat, and why one fly can fish three ways in a drift.

item.title: Camp Chef Sherpa Table Organizer Review: Hands-On
item.description: Hands-on Camp Chef Sherpa Table & Organizer review: aluminum folding top, sliding legs and four removable bags, plus how it works on a raft or in camp.

item.title: Devos LightRanger 2000 Review: Camp Light Tested
item.description: Hands-on Devos LightRanger 2000 review: a telescoping, Bluetooth-controlled LED camp light with red and white modes, tested at truck camps. $249.99.

item.title: River Rat Pro Series Raft Review: 12 ft Fishing Raft
item.description: River Rat Pro Series raft review: a 12 ft x 58 in Utah-built fishing raft with a 6 in drop-stitch floor, 1.5 in T6 aluminum frame and Class III rating.

item.title: Lid Rig Nippers Review: Magnetic Hat-Brim Nipper
item.description: Hands-on Lid Rig nippers review: how the magnetic, hinge-free nipper rides on your hat brim, the engineering behind it, and what changed in the 3.0.

item.title: Camp Chef Cast Iron Set Review: 6-Piece Kit
item.description: Hands-on Camp Chef cast iron set review for anglers and campers: what the 6-piece set includes, how each piece cooks, and who actually needs the full set.

item.title: Fly Fishing for Freshwater Stripers with Henry Cowen | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Henry Cowen on finding freshwater stripers with a fly rod: follow the bait, read water temperature, use sonar for structure, and learn from local anglers.

item.title: What Makes a Great Fly Reel? Kristen Mustad of Nautilus | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Nautilus founder Kristen Mustad on what separates a great fly reel: drag heat, sealed bearings, tested finishes, and how to pick a reel you can trust.
